subject: Medford Police Headquarters Groundbreaking
overview: City and state officials, police leadership, and community members gathered for the ceremonial groundbreaking of the new 35,000-square-foot Medford Police Headquarters. Speakers commemorated the project's planning history, flood resiliency and energy-efficient design, and its anticipated completion in approximately 20 months.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Official Recognitions
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke opened the ceremony, reflecting on the milestone for the city and recognizing attending city councilors, state legislators, and school committee members.

items.title: Invocation
items.summary: Medford Police Department Chaplain Father Robert Casey delivered an invocation for the construction of the facility and the safety of the workers and officers.

items.title: Police Union Remarks
items.summary: Medford Police Superior Officers Association President Bono and Patrolmen's Association President Harold McGilvray thanked city leadership and the public for their support in achieving modern working facilities.

items.title: District Attorney Address
items.summary: Middlesex County District Attorney Marian Ryan emphasized that the investment in a new facility reflects the community's commitment to modern public safety and dignity for officers.

items.title: Project Overview and Architectural Design
items.summary: Mayor Burke recognized municipal staff involved in the development, and architect Jeff Shaw detailed the 35,000-square-foot fossil-fuel-free design, solar installations, and flood resiliency measures.

items.title: Police Chief's Address
items.summary: Chief Jack Buckley thanked city leadership, honored department members, and invited 60-year administrative assistant Alva Erickson to take part in breaking ground.

items.title: Closing Benediction
items.summary: Father Casey delivered a closing blessing ahead of the ceremonial shoveling.
